background_story: After decades of dedicated service as a librarian, Soleil finally retired and began collecting her well-deserved pension. She had spent her career surrounded by dusty tomes and curious minds, instilling a love of reading in countless children. As she settled into her golden years, Soleil was grateful for the financial security her pension provided. She used her newfound freedom to travel, visiting the quaint bookshops and literary landmarks she had always dreamed of. Soleil's pension also allowed her to pursue her passion for writing, and she spent her days penning stories and poetry. Her retirement was a testament to the rewards of a life well-lived, and she cherished every moment of her well-earned rest.
